product.title: One kilogram. Four nines.
product.body: The 1kg cast bar is the workhorse of physical gold — large enough that the premium over spot stays thin, small enough to move, store, and sell without breaking the position apart.

items.title: Bars from refineries you can name
items.body: Heraeus and Metalor — refiners whose bars are recognised and resold without argument. A bar nobody has heard of is a discount waiting to happen.

items.title: Settled and vaulted in Hong Kong
items.body: Hong Kong's standing as a financial centre is the reason we are here. Vault storage or physical collection, arranged either way.

items.title: Built for mainland clients
items.body: Most of our clients come from the mainland. We know the questions that get asked, and we answer them before you have to ask.

items.title: Spot orders, quick settlement
items.body: Agree the price, settle, take delivery. No queue, and no product you did not ask for.

about.title: A Hong Kong bullion dealer.
about.lead: Global Partner & Resources Limited trades physical gold from Hong Kong, supplying investment-grade bars to private clients in Hong Kong and mainland China.

sections.title: What we do
sections.body: We buy and sell physical investment gold — principally the 1kg cast bar at 999.9 fineness, sourced from Heraeus and Metalor. We are a dealer, not a fund and not a platform. There is no account to open, no unit to redeem, and no counterparty standing between you and the metal. You buy a bar; you own that bar.

sections.title: Why Hong Kong
sections.body: Hong Kong levies no sales tax on investment gold, has deep banking infrastructure, and runs a settled legal system — which is why it remains the natural place in Asia to hold physical metal. Our office and vaulting arrangements are here, in Hung Hom, Kowloon.

sections.title: How we price
sections.body: Our price is the London spot price plus a dealing spread that depends on size. We tell you the spread before you commit. We would rather quote a number you can check against a public benchmark than a number you have to take on faith.

contact.title: Request a price.
contact.lead: Tell us the quantity you are considering and we will respond with a firm quote, settlement options, and vaulting or delivery arrangements.
contact.emailBody: Tell us the quantity you are considering and roughly when. We will reply with a firm price, settlement options, and vaulting or delivery arrangements.

footer.blurb: Physical gold bullion, dealt and settled in Hong Kong.
footer.disclaimer: The price of gold can fall as well as rise. Nothing on this site is investment advice or an offer to sell. Prices shown are indicative references, not dealable quotes.

sections.title: This site collects nothing
sections.body: There is no contact form, no sign-up, no analytics that profiles you, no advertising trackers and no marketing cookies. Reading these pages leaves us with no record of you.

sections.title: If you write to us
sections.body: When you email, call, or message us, we hold your details for one purpose: to answer you and to conduct any business that follows. We do not sell, rent, or share your details with third parties for their own marketing.

sections.title: Who else is involved
sections.body: This website is hosted by Vercel, which keeps standard server request logs on our behalf in order to serve the pages and defend against abuse. The gold reference price is fetched by our own server from a market data provider — your browser never contacts them, and nothing about you is sent to them.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep correspondence for as long as we have a business relationship with you, and afterwards only for as long as Hong Kong record-keeping obligations require.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us what personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Write to the email address on our contact page and we will respond.

sections.title: This site is information, not an offer
sections.body: Nothing on this website constitutes an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, gold or any other asset. A binding transaction exists only once terms are agreed directly with us in writing.

sections.title: Prices are indicative
sections.body: The reference price shown on this site is derived from the London spot price through a third-party data provider. It is indicative, it may be delayed, and it does not include our dealing spread. It is not a quote and cannot be traded on. Firm prices are given directly, on request, and are valid only for the period stated when quoted.

sections.title: Not investment advice
sections.body: We are a bullion dealer. We do not provide investment, tax, or legal advice, and nothing on this site should be read as a recommendation to buy or sell. The price of gold can fall as well as rise, and you may get back less than you paid. If you are unsure whether physical gold suits your circumstances, take independent advice.

sections.title: Accuracy
sections.body: We take care that the information here is correct, but we do not warrant that it is complete, current, or error-free, and we are not liable for loss arising from reliance on it.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the Hong Kong courts have exclusive jurisdiction.
